title: Rustfall
desc: Our biggest game: a post-apocalyptic roguelite. Survive the wasteland, fight through the biomes, mutate and push each run as deep as you can.

title: Echo's Swim
desc: Flappy Bird, but Echo is an axolotl: tap to swim up, glide through the coral gates, collect bubbles and beat your best swim.

title: Nova Siege
desc: A remastered retro pixel shooter: dodge the swarm, blast the galactic army, beat stage bosses, then bank credits to permanently upgrade your ship and unlock new hulls.

title: Arcane Citadel
desc: Two ways to hold the Citadel with Ember: a Quick Night (three waves, then Malgrath) or a Deep Night (endless waves, a boss every five, the full upgrade shop).

title: Tower Defence
desc: Build a kingdom through the ages and hold back the endless night: place defenders, upgrade them and survive each wave.

title: Ember Smash: Brick Forge
desc: Ember's brick breaker: slide the forge paddle, keep the spark alive and smash glowing bricks through six forges.

title: Gem Match
desc: A focused two-minute match-3 score attack: fire cascades, build bombs and wild gems, hit fever mode and push your best score as high as it goes.

title: Highway Dodge
desc: Swerve through oncoming traffic at high speed. There is always a gap, so chain near-misses for combo points, collect fuel and coins, then spend them on new cars and upgrades in the garage.

title: Sky High With Friends
desc: Solo sky-high climbing. Bounce Squirt the axolotl up the tower, ride gusts, grab coins and beat your best height.

title: Critter Whack: Ranger Sort
desc: Read the ranger clue, then tap only the critters that fit the habitat, movement or behaviour. Quick sorting fun, but watch out for hazards.

title: Crossy Crew
desc: Pip and Echo, brother and sister, lead the crew across busy roads and rushing rivers. Hop forward, dodge the traffic, ride the logs and see how far the crew can get.

title: Lumo's Hive Strike
desc: A tactical formation defence. Break the Hive's linked clusters, bank honey, draft garden boons and build honey turrets between waves, then topple a three-phase queen.

title: Lumo's Firefly Shooter
desc: A cosy hex match puzzle. Launch firefly bubbles into the hanging garden, match three or more colours, rescue fireflies and keep the shadow rows away from Lumo's lantern.

title: Stardust Snake
desc: Classic snake in a night sky: steer a trail of stardust into the fallen stars, grow your constellation and never drift into the edge or your own light.

title: Pip's Cozy Cove
desc: A calm fishing game with Pip the little turtle: charge your cast, aim for ripples and reel with care. Choose or craft bait, follow the tide, unlock new areas, meet Moonfin, keep fish in the aquarium, decorate the cove and save a postcard or catch card. Gentle mode turns reeling into a tap.

title: Call of the Cards
desc: A quick card duel: recruit companions, play tricks and hold 8 Power at the start of your turn, then storm the Fortress. Three to five minutes, one crown.

title: Backpack Quest
desc: A shaped-inventory dungeon roguelite: pack loot, build combos, choose routes, defeat bosses and save your best run.

title: Beat Builder Battle
desc: Compose your beat loop then battle rivals by tapping falling notes in time.

title: Bread Blocks
desc: Pack bread shapes into bakery trays, complete customer patterns, and chain clears in a cosy spatial puzzle game.

title: Bubble Pop Galaxy
desc: A juicy galaxy puzzle game full of chain reactions, colour missions, bombs, rockets, wild bubbles and a tricky boss.

title: Candy Kingdom Adventure
desc: A free kids tabletop RPG in the browser: one short Candy Kingdom adventure, three candy heroes, a d6 and no prep needed.

title: Biscuit Tin Clicker
desc: Play Biscuit Tin Clicker, a cosy free browser clicker game. Click, upgrade, repeat.

title: Cozy Cafe Match: Morning Rush
desc: One morning rush in Pip's cafe: serve 5 guests, match snacks and fill cravings, then shutters close.

title: Cozy Creatures
desc: A gentle kids browser game full of cosy creatures to find and snuggle. Safe, fun and free.

title: Creature Rescue Clinic
desc: Run a cosy creature rescue clinic: triage, diagnose, treat, upgrade rooms and finish a busy shift.

title: Crypt Crawlers
desc: A quick top-down roguelite dungeon run inspired by Binding of Isaac and Rustfall. Fight rooms, collect loot, adapt your build.

title: Dough Dash
desc: A fast bakery runner where players steer a dough ball through kitchen lanes, collect ingredients and avoid hazards.

title: Dungeon Delve: Map Logic
desc: Guide Lumo through one torch-lit dungeon. Read the clues, choose the route, find the key and escape before the torch burns out.

title: Echo's Casebook
desc: Solve randomised mystery cases. Read the clues, eliminate suspects and accuse the right one before time runs out.

title: Echo's Fruit Catch: Rainbow Picnic
desc: A gentle early-years sorting game. Catch the requested fruit, dodge the wrong ones and pack the rainbow picnic basket.

title: Lumo's Garden Defense
desc: A free browser lane defense game starring Lumo. Plant defenders, spend sunlight and keep the garden safe.

title: Little Steps
desc: Guide Pip through a maze trail, collect stars, avoid puddles and reach camp. A gentle adventure for young players.

title: Lumo's Dash
desc: An endless runner starring Lumo the purple fox. Jump gaps, slide under branches, collect stardust and keep dashing as the forest speeds up.

title: 3D Marble Run Creator
desc: Build and play a 3D marble run. Place raised track pieces, rotate the camera, launch the marble and solve the puzzle.

title: Quiz Quest
desc: Lumo's Crown Quiz: answer 5 questions, get 4 of 5 right and claim the crown.

title: Mini Theme Park Builder
desc: Build a tiny theme park sim with rides, paths, queues, guests, staff, prices and research.

title: Neon Tiles: Beat Builder
desc: A proper web rhythm game: song choice, falling notes, timing grades, combo streaks, health and unlockable neon tracks.

title: Nibble Quest: Orchard Routes
desc: Plan clever orchard routes, collect fruit in order, earn stars and solve handcrafted snake puzzles.

title: Paper Toss: Wind Lab
desc: Flick paper balls like a trick-shot arcade game: curve throws, read wind, bounce off desk clutter and nail the bin.

title: Pastry Match: One Order
desc: Read the customer's box, swap pastries, fill the order exactly and see it served.

title: Pip's Star Connect
desc: Trace the constellation Orion with Pip before the sky goes dark. Follow the glowing star route and learn the night sky.

title: Pip's Bakery Rush
desc: Run Pip's bakery through a busy shift: choose orders, prep dough, manage ovens, decorate bakes and serve customers.

title: Pixel Pet Arena
desc: Draw, care for, train and battle your own pixel pet in a cosy arena league.

title: Stack Attack
desc: A free one-button stacking game. Tap to drop blocks and build the tallest tower you can.

title: Star Chef: Recipe Queue
desc: Run a tiny space kitchen. Queue orders, cook recipe steps, plate meals and chain tips before patience runs out.

title: Stardust Ruins
desc: A Simon-says memory game in ancient ruins. Watch the glowing symbol sequence, repeat it back and unlock deeper chambers.

title: Stardust Constellation Rescue
desc: An educational browser game about reading symbol patterns, planning paths and rescuing lost constellations.

title: Tower Drop
desc: Tower Drop is a one-button stacking game. Tap to drop the swinging platform and build the tallest tower you can, starring Pip.

title: VoidRush: Chase the Sun
desc: A chase-the-sun arcade runner with authored sectors, boost gates, near-misses, shields, storms and a proper finish.
